notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Alex has a severe peanut allergy. It prints on her check-in label. Keep peanut snacks out of her room, and make sure every leader knows her epinephrine pen is in her bag.
notes.testPurpose: A pinned Safety Alert for a serious allergy on a child, written by staff outside the family.

replies.author: pete
replies.text: Thanks. I let the snack coordinators know too.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Talked to Ted today about starting a new young adults ministry.
notes.testPurpose: A legacy note from Rock's original sample data, on Rock's own Personal Note type.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Called Ted and heard that his mother is in the hospital and could use prayer.
notes.testPurpose: A legacy alert note on a staff member, from Rock's original sample data.

notes.author: pete
notes.testPurpose: A legacy private note: only Pete, its author, sees it on Ted's profile.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Cindy offered to help train the new prayer team volunteers this fall. {@alisha} can you add her to the training schedule?
notes.testPurpose: A note with a mention and a reply on a staff spouse, so her profile is not empty.

replies.author: alisha
replies.text: Done. She is on the schedule for the first two Sundays.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Cindy called to say the kids will be at their grandparents for the next two weekends. She asked us to tell their room leaders so no one worries when they are out.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Noah may leave the Grades 4-6 room on his own only to meet his dad in the production booth. Any other pickup needs his check-in tag.
notes.testPurpose: A Safety Alert about pickup on a staff child, written by staff outside the family.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Ted brought a real plan for a young adults night: one Thursday a month, dinner and a short talk. A dozen people in their twenties have already asked about it. {@jamal} will help him find two leaders. We meet again in two weeks to set a start date.
notes.testPurpose: A recent Follow-up note with a mention and a reply, picking up the young adults idea from his legacy note.

replies.author: jamal
replies.text: I have two names from the groups list already. I'll set up coffee with each of them.

notes.author: daniel
notes.text: Ted will tell the Community Serve Day story in the next church-wide email. He picked three photos his Production Team took that morning, and the draft goes to him by Friday.
notes.testPurpose: A Personal Note from the Director of Communications, tied to the Serve Day Ted leads.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Ted called in sick with the flu. Moved his meetings to next week, and Aaron is leading the Tuesday men's study in his place.
notes.testPurpose: A recent Phone Note from the church office on the demo family's dad.
